releasebot: DeployBot: hotfix v2026.04.01-embed-fastfix queued for prod-embeddings (region: eu-west1). Trigger: short-lived spike in embed 5xxs at 03:14Z. CI green. Please ack for expedited canary or provide rollback criteria.

kate: tagging SRE oncall. quick confirm: is this just the eviction backoff tweak?

rishi: yes, tiny change to eviction backoff (commit ffe12). No model changes.

kate: propose canary: 1% -> 10% (3m) -> 50% (5m) -> 100%. rollback if 5xx > baseline +0.5% or p95 > +40%.

oncall-sre: watching. +1 for fasttrack if two approvers.

nate: i approve. add release note blurb and container hash before full ramp.

releasebot: approvals: nate. initiating 1% canary now.

releasebot: canary 1% healthy -> promoted to 10%. metrics stable.

kate: holding 10m then proceed to 50. release note link: https://redwood-internal/docs/releases/2026-04-01-embed-fastfix

releasebot: 50% held 5m with no regressions -> rolling to 100%. rollout complete. if issues: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/embeddings-server -n prod`

rishi: will write postmortem and add better alerting for this error class. thanks team.
